notes.title: Update Progress Announcement
notes.content:
Hello community,

We know the current version of the game has some issues that have been affecting your experience, and we’re really sorry about that. We want you to know that we're working hard to fix these problems.

The upcoming update is taking longer than we thought it would. We know many of you have been looking forward to it, and we’re sorry for any frustration this might be causing.

To show our appreciation for your patience and support, we’d love for you to contact us at info@perlaoculta.com with proof of purchase of the game. Everyone who reaches out will get a small reward as a thank you for sticking with us.

Thanks for understanding and for all your support.

Cheers,
Perla Oculta team

notes.title: New update (v1.1.1): More bug fixing
notes.content:
The new update has arrived earlier than expected! We apologize for all the inconveniences of these first days and thank you for your infinite patience. We leave you with some of the most important changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that prevented you from starting the game if you had a saved game from previous versions.
[*]The language of the main menu is now updated correctly. 
[*]Fixed the keyboard bug in the MacOS version.
[*]Spelling corrections in the script
[/list]

Best regards,
Perla Oculta team

notes.title: An update is coming!
notes.content:
We are aware of the current issues with the game and have prepared a new build with fixes, but unfortunately, we are unable to update the game as we had a security issue yesterday and need Steam approval, which may take several hours. We hope it will be available tomorrow.

Again, sorry for the inconvenience. This release is not going as well as planned :(

notes.title: New update (1.1.0): Bug fixing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just updated the game fixing some bugs that you and the team have discovered since launch. Here is the list:

- Fixed a bug in the story flow that prevented unlocking colors.
- Fixed the pause button when using the mouse; now it's the right button.
- Fixed a bug that made some objects invisible during memories.
- Fixed a bug that prevented to save phone numbers.
- Added autosave between scenes. 
- Fixed other minor bugs.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Perla Oculta team

notes.title: Chromatic Memories is Now Available!
notes.content:
Our visual novel [b]Chromatic Memories[/b], an adventure set in the Canary Islands in the early 2000s, is [b]now available![/b] 

[i]"In a world where technology has made it possible to tinker with people’s minds, the so-called painters of memories can access and alter the people's brains, changing or even erasing their memories."[/i]

notes.title: Chromatic Memories will be launched on June 20, 2024.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We would like to inform you about an important change in the release date of Chromatic Memories. Due to unforeseen technical issues, we have decided to delay the release by one day to make sure the game is released in the best possible conditions. The new release date will be June 20, 2024.

We know that many of you are eager to dive into Nayara's story and explore the unique world we have created, for which we sincerely apologize. We hope that this short delay will be worth it and allow us to polish the final details of the game so that your experience will be optimal from day one.

We also wanted to take this message to everyone who participated in the Steam Next Fest and played the Chromatic Memories demo. Your support has been incredibly valuable to us.

Lastly, we invite you to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/oculta_perla]Twitter[/url] and to join our recent community on [url=https://discord.gg/t5xvaEZ3JZ]Discord[/url].

We greatly appreciate your understanding and patience. Thank you for your support.

Regards,
Perla Oculta team
